University Demolition Notice Sparks Student Protests Amid Allegations of Political Targeting

A demolition notice issued against 38 buildings of Mohammad Ali Jauhar University in Rampur has led to student protests. The university administration alleges political targeting, while authorities state the action is to enforce planning laws. The controversy also involves discussions around the legacy of Azam Khan and the future of minority education.
